S0.note: Reference interpretation. Verified: this session has real image input - all five originals were rendered and inspected directly, not described. No delegation; a child cannot see what the owner showed this session.

S1.note: Owner interview. Bounded by the owner's answers. Delegation would remove the owner from the loop.

S2.note: Art direction: one call, no tools. LIMITATION RECORDED: artistry accepts text only on this host, so the S0+S2 merge recommended in model-plan.md is unavailable and the S0 observations must be relayed as text. That relay is lossy. The economical S2 protocol (one-sentence design law per direction, causal mechanism over adjectives, inherited exclusions, two recorded rejections, separate critique pass) is applied regardless of model, per the 2026-09-09 bench finding that wording outweighed model choice.

S3.model: gpt-image-2.5-sunburst via the host generate_image tool
S3.note: Generation. Effort is not a parameter. Channel is image-tool: the host tool is called directly with the compiled prompt and sends {model, prompt, size, quality, n, output_format} with no system prompt or hidden template. Preset default was plain-chat, but this host exposes the image tool directly; the substitution is recorded here rather than made quietly. Sunburst is the most capable of the three offered models. Quota, not reasoning budget, is the limit: settle the direction before generating a wide grid.

S4.note: Implementation contract. Needs image input to read the selected concept and already holds the four records warm; a per-token premium child with file tools is the shape model-plan.md forbids.
